title: Website
body:
In an attempt to learn more about signal processing, I undertook the task of gaining an understanding of how the discrete fourier transform is performed. In the process of learning the math and ensuring a thorough understanding, I worked to develop code that would allow me to perform a discrete fourier transform on ambiguous data.

As part of this project I also went through and took some time to write code that would display the work that the DFT was performing for others as an instructional visual.
